newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Peco cut by Oppenheimer.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Peco cut by Oppenheimer.

text.p: -- Oppenheimer and Co said it downgraded PECO Energy Co to underperform. Market sources said the previous rating was market performer.
-- "Management supports higher expenses and lower wholesale revenues," an Oppeneheimer report on PECO said.
-- Oppenheimer sees the stock dropping to $20-$21, the report said. It was off 1-1/2 to 22-1/2.

-- Oppenheimer cut its earnings per share estimates "significantly" to $2.10 for 1997 and $2.15 for 1998, the report said. It did not list prior estimates. "We believe 1997 consensus earnings estimates of $2.60 are too high," it said.
